# Stack Seekers - Full Context

> Stack Seekers is an independent engineering consultancy led by Jiwan Ghosal. The company works with startups, product teams, and enterprise stakeholders that need senior technical execution around fractional CTO leadership, AI automation, programmatic SEO, cloud migration, product architecture, and backend performance.

## Who This Is For

- Founders who need senior technical leadership without hiring a full-time CTO
- Product teams dealing with scaling, delivery, or architecture bottlenecks
- Businesses that want AI features tied to real workflows and ROI
- Marketplaces, directories, and local-service platforms that need scalable organic acquisition
- Enterprise teams modernizing legacy platforms or shared frontend systems

## Core Offers

### Product Architecture & Scale

Design and stabilize the technical foundation of SaaS products and internal platforms. This includes architecture reviews, execution roadmaps, system boundaries, scale-readiness planning, and implementation support.

Page: https://stackseekers.com/web-development-services/product-architecture-and-scaling/

### ROI-Driven AI Automation

Design and implement LLM-powered systems that reduce manual work and improve product capability. This includes automation discovery, prompt and context architecture, workflow integration, and production delivery.

Page: https://stackseekers.com/web-development-services/ai-and-automation-strategy/

### Fractional CTO Strategy

Provide technical roadmap planning, delivery oversight, vendor review, architecture leadership, and engineering decision support without requiring a full-time executive hire.

Page: https://stackseekers.com/web-development-services/fractional-cto-and-advisory/

### Enterprise Cloud Migration

Plan and deliver migrations away from fragile legacy systems into maintainable, cloud-ready architectures with staged rollout and low disruption.

Page: https://stackseekers.com/web-development-services/enterprise-cloud-migration/

### Programmatic Growth Engines

Build scalable programmatic SEO systems with landing-page templates, structured data inputs, internal linking, and lead capture designed around commercial search intent.

Page: https://stackseekers.com/web-development-services/programmatic-seo-and-growth/

### High-Performance API Design

Improve API latency, service boundaries, integration reliability, and backend responsiveness for products under increasing scale or complexity.

Page: https://stackseekers.com/web-development-services/api-performance-and-integration/

## Commercial Proof

- ABN AMRO: enterprise migration and platform modernization work
- Upstox: reduced lead turnaround from 4 days to 2 hours
- Qatar Airways: high-performance booking and frontend engineering work
